attestations.text: Ch'ien Ming-shih 錢名世 (亮工, 絅庵), a native of Wu-chin, Kiangsu, and the t'an-hua 探花 or third ranking chin-shih of 1703, wrote a poem in praise of Nien and gave him the entire credit for recovering Tibet (1720).
